title: group_metrics: Prometheus gauge values persist across server restart — stale gauges until first sample
description: group_metrics.rs: Prometheus gauges (GROUP_LOG_ENTRIES_TOTAL, GROUP_STORAGE_BYTES, GROUP_LAST_ACTIVITY_TIMESTAMP) are process-global. After a restart the gauges start at 0 and jump to the real value only after the first sample_group_metrics call. For a group that no longer exists in the articles table, its gauge retains the pre-restart value indefinitely because the GROUP BY query omits it (no row → no set call). The gauge is never reset to 0 for deleted groups. This is inherent to Prometheus gauges without explicit deletion. Consider calling gauge.remove(label) for groups that drop out of the GROUP BY result, or document the known staleness.
